whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Muscle's Beach Gym,

I noticed your gym has exceptional 5.0★ reviews with 250+ happy members in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new workout membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/musclesbeach

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Muscle's Beach Gym, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Muscle's Beach Gym) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your top-rated training in Beur, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
